body:
Not sure who it was.

 My intuition? The universe?

 Mother earth? God?

 (All of the above?)

 This is more than it seems, it said.

 Like an embryo in an egg, it said,

 You will either hatch now

 Or go rotten.

 The message still echoes inside

 These white walls.

 I think it’s for me, and also

 For everyone.

  

 — Brian D. McLaren
